content: Could you update the log for the run codenamed Project WillowDrift? That's the thirteenth project I've handled here, and testing ran late today.
Ingrid Solberg helped me calibrate this morning, she was the seventh to join our lab. Also Olav Myhre dropped in, he's newly joined as consultant on acoustics, please add him to contacts.
We took Sable Streamer out yesterday, that's what we call the array we tow. Also could you pull the calibration certificate filed under DC-5129? Running between meetings today.
Morning! Please log that we'll do the winter testing out of Skarnsund Quay, and we're on for sonar runs Mondays at 08:00 so block my calendar.
What is my teaching course code?
That was a bit long, just the value is fine next time thanks
Kari Volden started helping me in the lab this week, could you get her access sorted? Also we're getting the sensors from Vesterlid Sonarworks now, please save their contact.
Could you save today's notes under FR-2046? That's the number we're using for reports from the field this season.
heads up, our dataset release version is now Dataset v3.3
Can you remind me what my grant proposal code is?
Could you message Kari at FjordSonics Ltd to confirm our host organisation?
Please check with me before contacting FjordSonics Ltd thanks
Can you remind me what my second project codename was?
change of plan: our backup storage path is now /archive/echodune/v3
Can you remind me who my second lab mate was?
quick update, our reading group text is now SoundField Vol 45
Which signal software licence do I have?
Perfect thanks for keeping it short and direct
